description: This file contains utility functions for styling, including merging style objects, appending classes to style targets, creating theme styles from color palettes, and converting keys to CSS property names.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges multiple style objects into one, handling prefix conflicts.

methods.name: appendToAll
methods.description: Appends class keys to all entries in a target style object, with exclusions.

methods.name: createThemeStyles
methods.description: Generates CSS variable styles from a set of color palettes.

methods.name: toProp
methods.description: Converts a key into a CSS variable name, handling 'nv' prefix.
